metadata.title: Complete the contrast between Galilean kinematics and the optical null result.

params.taskDescription: Complete the contrast between Galilean kinematics and the optical null result.
params.textField: The Galilean rule gives u′x = *ux − v*. It therefore predicts an *ether wind* for a moving laboratory, whereas Michelson–Morley found *no systematic fringe shift*. Einstein instead required every inertial observer to measure the same vacuum light speed *c*.

metadata.title: Mark the two statements that form Einstein’s postulates.

params.taskDescription: Mark the two statements that form Einstein’s postulates.
params.textField: The *laws of physics have the same form in every inertial frame*, and the *vacuum speed of light is the same for every inertial observer*. An ether wind and absolute uniform motion are therefore not observable.
